cross_configuration_rule: For each host, the six unmarked CLEAN string-carrier builds must give equal observation triples on every input; a difference is reported, not repaired.
observation: exit status, exact stdout bytes, exact stderr bytes; timeout 5 s per execution
question: Do a larger predeclared input set and the full process observation (exit status, stdout, stderr) change any marked-versus-unmarked host judgment, and do sanitizer builds report undefined behaviour on any input?
random_seed_rule: first 8 bytes of SHA-256 of the schema name, big-endian, Python random.Random, 64 draws of getrandbits(64)
sanitizer_rule: gcc -O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -fno-omit-frame-pointer on the unmarked, string-marked and symbol-marked CLEAN source; a finding is any run whose stderr contains a sanitizer report or whose exit status is the sanitizer failure status.
success_criterion: None; every verdict is reported as observed.
verdict_rule: For an input set S: INADMISSIBLE if either build failed or any execution in S timed out or could not be launched; SATISFIED if the marked and unmarked observation triples are equal on every input of S; otherwise INCONSISTENT.
